blocks.en: Abyssal Deadspace is a mysterious area of isolated space which players can enter to try to complete time-limited PvE combat challenges in order to obtain lucrative rewards.
blocks.zh: 深渊（Abyssal Deadspace）是一片神秘的隔绝空间，玩家可以进入其中挑战限时 PvE 战斗，以获取丰厚的奖励。

blocks.en: Pilots can only enter abyssal deadspace by using special filaments, and even then only limited pockets are accessible for a limited time. The pockets are filled with dangerous localized space effects and any ship that ventures away from the stable pocket or stays in for too long will be destroyed by these effects.
blocks.zh: 飞行员只能通过特殊的纤维进入深渊，即便如此，也只能在有限的时间内进入有限的口袋空间。这些口袋空间充满了危险的局部空间效应，任何驶离稳定口袋区域或停留过久的舰船都会被这些效应摧毁。

blocks.en: Abyssal mechanics
blocks.zh: 深渊机制

blocks.en: Running Abyssals can be fun and profitable, but it is very important that pilots grasp the core mechanics involved, as--unlike most PvE combat in EVE--failure means the certain loss of both ship and pod.
blocks.zh: 刷深渊既有趣又赚钱，但飞行员务必掌握其中的核心机制，因为——与 EVE 中大多数 PvE 战斗不同——失败意味着必定同时损失舰船和太空舱。

blocks.en: Entry
blocks.zh: 进入

blocks.en: Tier 1 filament: The info of the filament shows what the properties of the site it opens are. That it is a Tier 1 filament can be seen by the 1 glowing stripe on the icon.
blocks.zh: 1 级纤维：纤维的信息中显示了它所开启站点的属性。图标上有 1 条发光条纹，说明这是 1 级纤维。

blocks.en: Pilots can enter Abyssal deadspace using Abyssal filaments obtained from data sites, from abyssal deadspace itself, or purchased from the in-game market. Seven tiers of increasing difficulty exist, numbered from 0 to 6. Entry into the Abyss is limited to either:
blocks.zh: 飞行员可以使用深渊纤维进入深渊，纤维可以从数据站点、深渊本身获得，也可以在游戏市场上购买。纤维共有七个等级，难度依次递增，编号从 0 到 6。进入深渊的舰船限制为以下之一：

en: A single Tech 1, Tech 2, Navy Faction or Pirate Faction cruiser; T3 Strategic Cruisers cannot enter
Up to two destroyers, at the cost of 2 filaments; Unlike cruisers, T3 variants of destroyers are allowed
Up to three frigates, at the cost of 3 filaments
zh: 一艘 T1、T2、海军势力或海盗势力巡洋舰；T3 战略巡洋舰不能进入
最多两艘驱逐舰，需要消耗 2 根纤维；与巡洋舰不同，T3 驱逐舰可以进入
最多三艘护卫舰，需要消耗 3 根纤维

blocks.en: To enter the Abyss, activate the filament(s) while in space. When activated, a beacon (named Abyssal trace) is created at your entry location. If a frigate or destroyer Abyssal trace is opened, only a fleet can activate it. The Abyssal trace can be scanned down using combat probes, which means that sufficiently motivated players might be able to find it and await your return from the pocket.
blocks.zh: 要进入深渊，需在太空中激活纤维。激活后，会在你的进入位置生成一个信标（名为深渊踪迹（Abyssal trace））。如果开启的是护卫舰或驱逐舰的深渊踪迹，只有舰队才能激活它。深渊踪迹可以用战斗探针扫描定位，这意味着有足够动机的玩家可能会找到它，并守在那里等你从口袋空间回来。

blocks.en: Activation can be carried out anywhere in space, as long as the following conditions are satisfied:
blocks.zh: 只要满足以下条件，就可以在太空中任何位置激活纤维：

en: No Gates, Stations or mobile depots at less than 1000 km.
No other Abyssal trace at less than 1000 km.
The player does not have a capsuleer log-off timer active.
zh: 1000 km 内没有星门、空间站或移动式仓库。
1000 km 内没有其他深渊踪迹。
玩家没有处于克隆飞行员下线计时状态。

blocks.en: To keep their abyssal trace more secure, most players activate their filaments at safespot bookmarks.
blocks.zh: 为了让深渊踪迹更安全，大多数玩家会在安全点书签处激活纤维。

blocks.en: Only Tranquil Abyssal Filaments (T0) can be opened in 1.0 (Exordium) and 0.9 security systems. Higher tiers require 0.8 or lower security and triggering an abyssal filament in high security space can also trigger a suspect timer. This is based on the filament tier and the security of the system.
blocks.zh: 在 1.0（始源星域）和 0.9 安全等级的星系中只能开启宁静深渊纤维（T0）。更高等级的纤维需要 0.8 或更低的安全等级，而在高安激活深渊纤维还可能触发可疑计时。这取决于纤维等级和星系安全等级。

blocks.en: A long, long time ago...
blocks.zh: 很久很久以前……

blocks.en: Before 2026-05-19.1 (23.02), abyssal filaments could not be activated in 1.0 or 0.9 space .Tier 4 and 5 (T6 didn't exist yet) abyssal filaments used to always give players a suspect timer by default when used, regardless of system security. The suspect flag mechanics were reworked following the Nov. 4, 2022 patch to the security scaling system shown above.
blocks.zh: 在 2026-05-19.1（23.02）之前，深渊纤维不能在 1.0 或 0.9 星系中激活。4 级和 5 级（当时还没有 T6）深渊纤维过去在使用时默认总会给玩家可疑计时，不论星系安全等级如何。2022 年 11 月 4 日的补丁将可疑标记机制改成了上表所示的按安全等级分级的系统。

blocks.en: Abyssal layout
blocks.zh: 深渊布局

blocks.en: An Abyssal Deadspace instance is composed of three pockets, frequently called "rooms" by players. Each pocket contains enemies and a gate to the next pocket; you will always spawn anywhere from 35-70 km away from the gate and the enemies will be sitting at 0 on it. The gate only unlocks once all enemies in the pocket are cleared.
blocks.zh: 一个深渊实例由三个口袋空间组成，玩家常称之为“房间”。每个口袋空间中都有敌人和一道通往下一个口袋的传送门；你总会出现在距离传送门 35-70 km 的地方，而敌人就停在传送门 0 距离处。只有清空口袋中的所有敌人后，传送门才会解锁。

blocks.en: The enemies in the pocket are randomly selected from a range of spawns appropriate to the tier of the filament used. Higher tier filaments take you to pockets with larger spawns, (much) more dangerous enemies and a larger variety of said enemies. Some pockets may contain enemies who are in combat against each other in lore. However, none of these factions will be allied with you. You must fight your own way out.
blocks.zh: 口袋中的敌人是从与所用纤维等级相应的刷新组合中随机选出的。纤维等级越高，口袋里的怪群越大，敌人（危险得多）也越多样。有些口袋中可能会出现在背景设定里彼此敌对的敌人，但这些势力都不会站在你这边。你只能自己杀出一条路。

blocks.en: Abyssal NPCs leave no wrecks to loot or salvage, and have no bounties. Destroying them will also not penalize your standings with their related faction - what happens in the Abyss, stays in the Abyss.
blocks.zh: 深渊 NPC 不会留下可供拾取或打捞的残骸，也没有赏金。击毁它们也不会影响你对其相关势力的声望——深渊里发生的事，就留在深渊里。

blocks.en: Loot
blocks.zh: 拾取物

blocks.en: Triglavian Bioadaptive Cache contains the loot for each pocket.
blocks.zh: 每个口袋的拾取物都在三神裔生物适应性储藏（Triglavian Bioadaptive Cache）中。

blocks.en: Triglavian Extraction Nodes also contains additional loot.
blocks.zh: 三神裔提取节点（Triglavian Extraction Node）中也有额外的拾取物。

blocks.en: Each pocket also contains a structure called the "Triglavian Bioadaptive Cache" which has a scant 300 hit points and which, once destroyed, drops most of the loot for that pocket.
blocks.zh: 每个口袋中还有一个名为“三神裔生物适应性储藏”的建筑，它只有区区 300 点耐久，被摧毁后会掉落该口袋的大部分拾取物。

blocks.en: In all but the easiest (Tier 0) Abyssals, there are also "Triglavian Extraction Nodes" and "Triglavian Extraction SubNodes" which also contain additional loot. These extra cans are often placed far away from the conduit, have a limited loot pool (Survey Databases, Zero-Point Condensate and Crystalline Isogen-10), and sometimes will contain nothing inside of them at a random chance, so going after these should only be done if you have ample time to spare in your run.
blocks.zh: 除最简单的（0 级）深渊外，还会有“三神裔提取节点”和“三神裔提取子节点”，里面也有额外的拾取物。这些额外的货柜通常离传送门很远，掉落池有限（三神裔调查数据库、零度凝缩液和晶体同位聚合体-10），有时还会随机地什么都没有，所以只有在你这次深渊时间非常充裕时才值得去打。

blocks.en: Cache wrecks can be salvaged for Triglavian materials, though the time- and ISK-efficiency of doing this is dubious.
blocks.zh: 储藏的残骸可以打捞出三神裔材料，不过这样做在时间和 ISK 上是否划算很难说。

blocks.en: Time and space limits
blocks.zh: 时间与空间限制

blocks.en: The deadspace instance is stable for only 20 minutes. If you are still in the pocket after 20 minutes your ship and your pod will be immediately destroyed.
blocks.zh: 死亡空间实例只能稳定存在 20 分钟。如果 20 分钟后你还在口袋中，你的舰船和太空舱会被立即摧毁。

blocks.en: Note: 3 May 2024 Exploit Notification - Extending Abyssal Timers
blocks.zh: 注：2024 年 5 月 3 日 漏洞利用通知 - 延长深渊计时器

blocks.en: You must clear the three pockets and exit within the allocated time, or you will lose both your ship and your pod. The third pocket gate returns you to the location in space where you activated the filament. To finish the Abyssal run within the 20-minute limit, you must achieve a faster average pocket clear time than 6.66 minutes.
blocks.zh: 你必须在规定时间内清完三个口袋并离开，否则舰船和太空舱都会损失。第三个口袋的传送门会把你送回你激活纤维时所在的太空位置。要在 20 分钟限制内完成深渊，每个口袋的平均清理时间必须少于 6.66 分钟。

blocks.en: Each pocket is surrounded by dangerous space which will destroy your ship and pod if you enter it. This space appears as a red graphical effect which becomes more obvious the closer you fly toward it.
blocks.zh: 每个口袋周围都是危险空间，一旦进入就会摧毁你的舰船和太空舱。这片空间显示为红色的视觉效果，你飞得越近就越明显。

blocks.en: Restrictions
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Other restrictions on Abyssals are:
blocks.zh: 深渊的其他限制包括：

en: Fleet-mates cannot warp to you while you are within the Abyss, nor can you warp out of it.
You cannot deploy a mobile depot.
There is no Local chat channel.
If you start a probe scan with Core Probes and Combat probes, probes will take damage when they move outside of the pocket boundary, and will soon be destroyed as they have low structure HP.
zh: 你在深渊中时，舰队成员无法跃迁到你身边，你也无法跃迁离开。
如果你用核心探针和战斗探针进行探针扫描，探针移出口袋边界后会受到伤害，由于结构值很低，很快就会被摧毁。

blocks.en: If a player is in Abyssal Deadspace when server downtime occurs, the player will return to the solar system from which they entered. Any drones must be recovered before the server goes down, or they will be lost.
blocks.zh: 如果服务器维护（宕机）时玩家还在深渊中，玩家会被送回进入时所在的星系。无人机必须在服务器关闭前回收，否则会丢失。

blocks.en: Three types of gates you will encounter are: Triglavian Origin Conduit, Triglavian Transfer Conduit, and Triglavian Proving Conduit. These gates will be folded closed until all enemies have been destroyed, after which they will (quite spectacularly) open and energize. A gate with a triangle in the center means you still have more pockets to go! (Note that at the time of writing, fall 2021, the Proving Conduit does not appear; its mechanic has been replaced by the Triglavian Proving Grounds.)
blocks.zh: 你会遇到三种传送门：三神裔起源导管（Triglavian Origin Conduit）、三神裔转移导管（Triglavian Transfer Conduit）和三神裔试炼导管（Triglavian Proving Conduit）。这些传送门在所有敌人被消灭前都是折叠关闭的，之后会（相当壮观地）展开并充能。传送门中心有三角形，说明后面还有口袋！（注意，在撰写本文时，即 2021 年秋季，试炼导管已不再出现；其机制已被三神裔试炼场取代。）

en: WARNING: Any ship and capsule should be considered potentially lost the moment a player enters Abyssal Deadspace. Abyssals are unforgiving to inexperienced, ill-equipped or foolhardy pilots. If your ship is lost inside the site, you will lose your capsule, clone, and any implants equipped as well. Running Abyssals can be a fun and profitable challenge, but do not enter Abyssal Deadspace with a ship or with implants that you cannot afford to lose.
zh: 警告：玩家一旦进入深渊，就应当把舰船和太空舱都视为可能已经损失。深渊对缺乏经验、装备不足或鲁莽的飞行员毫不留情。如果你的舰船在站点内被击毁，你还会损失太空舱、克隆以及身上装的所有植入体。刷深渊可以是一项有趣又赚钱的挑战，但不要驾驶你损失不起的舰船或带着损失不起的植入体进入深渊。

blocks.en: Environmental Effects
blocks.zh: 环境效应

blocks.en: Abyssal deadspace has several environmental effects that will all apply to both the player ship and the NPC ships. These effects will disadvantage unprepared ships, but they can be predicted from the type of filament used, and players can use them to their advantage.
blocks.zh: 深渊有若干环境效应，对玩家舰船和 NPC 舰船都同样生效。这些效应会让没有准备的舰船处于劣势，但可以根据所用纤维的类型提前预判，玩家也可以加以利用。

blocks.en: All effects applied to your ship will be shown in the same location as EWAR effects; by default, this is above the capacitor and health displays, at the centre of the base of your screen. Hover your mouse over the icon to see what effect is applied to your ship.
blocks.zh: 作用在你舰船上的所有效应都显示在与电子战效果相同的位置；默认是在屏幕底部中央、电容和血量显示的上方。将鼠标悬停在图标上，可以查看作用在你舰船上的效应。

blocks.en: Weather Effects
blocks.zh: 天气效应

blocks.en: Each Abyssal Deadspace site will have one of five pairs of weather effects comprised of one bonus, and one penalty. These effects are intrinsic to success, as they are highly impactful. It is important to note that since both the "bonus" and "penalty" components of any weather apply to all entities, the "bonus" can end up being a bonus to the player, and/or a penalty to the player by virtue of being a bonus to the enemies, and similarly vice versa with the "penalty" component. Not every bonus is impactful in every situation, and the same goes for penalties, so it is critical to consider these effects when planning a ship/fleet build, strategies, and tactics.
blocks.zh: 每个深渊站点都有五组天气效应中的一组，每组包含一项增益和一项惩罚。这些效应影响巨大，是成败的关键。需要注意的是，由于任何天气的“增益”和“惩罚”都对所有单位生效，“增益”可能对玩家有利，也可能因为增强了敌人而对玩家不利；“惩罚”同样如此。并非每项增益在所有情况下都有影响，惩罚也一样，因此在规划舰船/舰队配置、策略和战术时，务必考虑这些效应。

blocks.en: The bonus and penalty effects found in each of the five kinds of weather are as follows:
blocks.zh: 五种天气各自的增益和惩罚效应如下：

zh: 炮台最佳射程和失准范围 -30/50/70%

blocks.en: Penalty strength selection:
blocks.zh: 惩罚强度的选取：

blocks.en: The strength of the penalty found in a given site is determined by a roll between either 30% or 50% through tier 3, and a roll between either 50% or 70% in tier 4 and above, as described in the table below:
blocks.zh: 站点中惩罚的强度是随机决定的：3 级及以下在 30% 和 50% 之间随机，4 级及以上在 50% 和 70% 之间随机，如下表所示：

blocks.en: These bonuses and penalties may be addressed in the following ways:
blocks.zh: 可以用以下方式应对这些增益和惩罚：

blocks.en: Resistance penalties (all weathers but Dark): These will increase the amount of damage taken in the damage type of the resistance penalty. These penalties are addressed by covering this hole on your ship(s), and ensuring that you are putting out damage that matches this resist hole as closely as possible. By forgoing the resist hole, one is choosing to fight against the natural resistances of the NPCs, just as one would in Dark weather, which lacks a resistance penalty.
blocks.zh: 抗性惩罚（除黑暗外的所有天气）：会增加你受到的对应类型伤害。应对方法是补上自己舰船的这个抗性缺口，并尽量让自己打出的伤害与这个抗性缺口一致。如果不利用这个抗性缺口，就等于要硬打 NPC 的天然抗性，就像在没有抗性惩罚的黑暗天气中一样。

blocks.en: Turret optimal and falloff penalty (Dark): As this applies to not only NPC and player turrets but player drone turrets, it is inadvisable to bring turret or drone boats to these sites, and to use launchers instead. Additionally, missiles lack of navigation requirements for the purposes of damage application, enable the player to more easily and better take advantage of the maximum velocity bonus found in this weather. This penalty will dramatically reduce the amount of tank requirement/damage taken by players due to the NPC AI not correcting for the reduced range; they will fire on you from outside optimal, and often even outside 1x falloff or more, and consistently miss. Finally, this penalty means that there is no resist penalty, and therefore no resist hole to attack. This weather will require more damage output than most others, save potentially Firestorm.
blocks.zh: 炮台最佳射程和失准范围惩罚（黑暗）：由于这一惩罚不仅作用于 NPC 和玩家的炮台，也作用于玩家无人机的炮台，所以不建议开炮台船或无人机船来这类站点，而应该用发射器。此外，导弹在伤害投射上没有航行方面的要求，玩家可以更轻松、更充分地利用这种天气中的最大速度增益。由于 NPC 的 AI 不会因射程缩短而调整，它们会在最佳射程之外、甚至经常在 1 倍失准范围以外向你开火，并且一直打不中，因此这一惩罚会大幅降低玩家所需的坦度和受到的伤害。最后，这种天气意味着没有抗性惩罚，也就没有可以攻击的抗性缺口。这种天气需要的输出比其他大多数天气都高，可能仅次于火瀑。

blocks.en: Maximum Velocity bonus (Dark): Enemies and player drones will only use the bonused attribute of "Maximum Velocity" when chasing. When in their desired range, they will use their normal, un-bonused "Orbit Velocity". Players, however, are able to control how much of their max velocity they are using, and thus can fully benefit from this bonus. Better pay extra attention to those Tachyon clouds, though!
blocks.zh: 最大速度增益（黑暗）：敌人和玩家无人机只有在追击时才会用到增益后的“最大速度”属性。到达理想距离后，它们会使用未经增益的普通“环绕速度”。而玩家可以自己控制使用多少最大速度，因此可以充分享受这项增益。不过最好格外留意那些超光速云（Tachyon cloud）！

blocks.en: Capacitor recharge time bonus (Electrical): This bonus effectively grants not a 50% bonus, but rather 100%, as it halves capacitor recharge time, thereby doubling the capacitor recharge rate. NPCs receive essentially no benefit from this bonus, but players are able to leverage the additional capacitor regen to great effect. Ship fits for this tier can afford to run many more cap-hungry tank mods than usual and still have little problem, and as such Electrical is generally considered one of the easiest weathers. The resist penalty may still be a issue for shield tanked ships with an EM resist hole in some rooms, namely Angel and Sansha, which deal heavy EM damage.
blocks.zh: 电容回充时间增益（电子）：这项增益实际上不是 50%，而是 100%，因为它把电容回充时间减半，从而使电容回充速率翻倍。NPC 基本享受不到这项增益，而玩家却能充分利用额外的电容回充。这种天气下的装配可以比平时多带很多耗电的坦克装备而基本没问题，因此电子通常被认为是最简单的天气之一。不过，对于有电磁抗性缺口的护盾坦克舰船来说，在某些房间里抗性惩罚仍可能是个问题，即造成大量电磁伤害的天使和萨沙。

blocks.en: Armor hit point bonus (Firestorm): This bonus is the opposite of what is found in Electrical sites, in a way - it is usually not relevant to player ships, only in certain cases, and is highly impactful to the enemies. As many enemies you will encounter in these sites are armor-heavy, this will dramatically increase the time-to-kill for each individual enemy, thereby keeping threats on the field longer, and increasing overall site time. The hit point bonus on the player ship can be relevant to players running destroyers and frigates, to some degree, though is largely unimpactful for players using cruisers. Firestorm is generally known as the most difficult weather.
blocks.zh: 装甲值增益（火瀑）：某种意义上，这项增益与电子站点正好相反——它通常只在特定情况下与玩家舰船相关，却对敌人影响极大。由于这类站点中你遇到的很多敌人都是重装甲，这会大幅延长击杀每个敌人所需的时间，让威胁在场上停留更久，从而增加整个站点的用时。玩家舰船上的血量增益对开驱逐舰和护卫舰的玩家在一定程度上有用，但对开巡洋舰的玩家影响不大。火瀑通常被公认为最难的天气。

blocks.en: Shield hit point bonus (Gamma): While most enemies are armor-heavy and some (Lucid Sleepers of the Vigilant Tyrannos) lack shield entirely, there is more than enough shield HP present for this to present a time challenge compared to sites without a hit point bonus, though less of a challenge than Firestorm. In terms of players leveraging this bonus, players are able to utilize the increased shield regeneration that comes along with the increased hit points, building passive shield regeneration tanks that can handle massive amounts of damage. NPC shields found here generally are designed to effectively not regenerate whatsoever, and thus do not gain a notable amount of regeneration from this bonus.
blocks.zh: 护盾值增益（伽玛）：虽然大多数敌人都是重装甲，有些（Vigilant Tyrannos 的 Lucid 冬眠者）甚至完全没有护盾，但场上的护盾值总量仍然足以让站点比没有血量增益的站点更费时间，只是没有火瀑那么难。在利用这项增益方面，玩家可以利用随护盾值增加而提升的护盾回充，打造能承受巨量伤害的被动护盾回充坦克。这里的 NPC 护盾一般被设计成基本不会回充，因此不会从这项增益中获得明显的回充提升。

blocks.en: Scan resolution bonus (Exotic): Largely irrelevant, be aware that NPCs will lock you faster, enjoy locking NPCs faster. The kinetic damage bonus is generally more of a boon.
blocks.zh: 扫描分辨率增益（异种）：基本无关紧要，留意 NPC 会更快锁定你，同时享受更快锁定 NPC 的便利就好。动能伤害加成通常更有用。

blocks.en: Localized Effects
blocks.zh: 局部效应

blocks.en: Filament Cloud (orange) and Bioluminescence Clouds (blue)
blocks.zh: 纤维云（橙色）和生物荧光云（蓝色）

blocks.en: Deviant Automata Suppressor
blocks.zh: 异常自动机抑制器（Deviant Automata Suppressor）

blocks.en: The pockets will also contain clouds and Triglavian towers that apply effects to player and NPC ships in their immediate vicinity.
blocks.zh: 口袋中还会有一些云团和三神裔塔，对其附近的玩家和 NPC 舰船施加效果。

blocks.en: Localized Clouds:
blocks.zh: 局部云团：

en: Filament Cloud (orange): Penalty to Shield Booster boosting (-40%) and reduction to shield booster duration (-40%). If using a conventional (not Ancillary) shield booster, in effect this does not weaken your shield booster, but rather increases its capacitor cost per second by 66%. If you rely on a shield booster to survive, you should avoid entering these clouds.

Bioluminescence Cloud (light blue): +300% Signature Radius (4.0x signature radius multiplier). Entering this cloud will make your ship an easier target to hit but it will also make all rats easier to hit. If fighting small but accurate enemies like Damaviks, this cloud can actually be helpful, and you can lure the rats into it. Large ships (like the Abyssal Overminds) will be able to hit you much more easily (and much harder in the case of Marshals) - stay out of these clouds if you are speed-tanking a battleship room.

Tachyon Cloud (white): +300% Velocity (x4.0 velocity), -50% Inertia Modifier. Be very careful entering this cloud with an active MWD, as the inertia reduction will cause you to accelerate very quickly (x4 velocity, x0.5 inertia, x8 acceleration), potentially slingshotting you outside the pocket boundary for a very quick death. These clouds will also increase enemy velocities, causing them to either close range very quickly, or suddenly pull away. Drone-reliant ships should beware of these clouds as well since drones will struggle with damage application to enemies inside these clouds.
zh: 纤维云（橙色）：护盾回充增量器的回充量降低（-40%），回充周期缩短（-40%）。如果使用的是普通（非辅助）护盾回充增量器，实际上并不会削弱回充效果，而是使其每秒电容消耗增加 66%。如果你依赖护盾回充增量器生存，就应避免进入这类云团。
生物荧光云（浅蓝色）：信号半径 +300%（信号半径乘数 4.0 倍）。进入这类云团会让你的舰船更容易被击中，但也会让所有怪更容易被击中。如果对付的是达玛维克级这类体型小但命中准的敌人，这种云团反而有帮助，你可以把怪引进去。大型舰船（如 Abyssal Overmind）会更容易击中你（Marshal 的话还会打得更狠）——如果你在战列舰房间里靠速度坦，就别进这些云团。
超光速云（白色）：速度 +300%（速度 4.0 倍），惯性调整系数 -50%。开着微型跃迁推进器进入这种云团要非常小心，因为惯性降低会让你加速非常快（速度 x4，惯性 x0.5，加速度 x8），可能把你直接甩出口袋边界，转眼就死。这些云团也会提高敌人的速度，让它们要么迅速拉近距离，要么突然拉开。依赖无人机的舰船也要小心这些云团，因为无人机很难把伤害打到云团里的敌人身上。

blocks.en: A long, long time ago...
blocks.zh: 很久很久以前……

blocks.en: In September, 2020, the Tachyon Cloud was introduced, replacing the older Caustic Cloud. The Caustic Cloud applied a -80% penalty to local and remote Armor Repair modules, making it a death sentence for armor tanked ships. However, the cloud was very rarely seen.
blocks.zh: 2020 年 9 月，超光速云取代了旧的腐蚀云。腐蚀云会使本地和远程装甲维修装备降低 80%，对装甲坦克舰船来说等于死刑。不过这种云团非常少见。

blocks.en: Triglavian Towers:
blocks.zh: 三神裔塔：

en: Deviant Automata Suppressor: Damages all missiles, drones, and rogue drone frigates within its area of effect. Flying into the range of this Suppressor can help you take out pirate drones. Watch out for your own drones.
Medium-Range: 40km. Approximately the same damage as a medium smartbomb. Usually does not kill light missiles.
Short-Range: 15km. More than double the DPS of the Medium-Range. Kills light misslies and drones very quickly.
zh: 异常自动机抑制器：对其作用范围内的所有导弹、无人机和自由无人机护卫舰造成伤害。飞进这种抑制器的范围可以帮你消灭海盗无人机。注意你自己的无人机。
中程：40km。伤害与中型立体炸弹大致相当。通常打不掉轻型导弹。
短程：15km。每秒伤害是中程的两倍以上。能很快摧毁轻型导弹和无人机。

en: Multibody Tracking Pylon: Tracking bonus to all ships (including NPCs) in its area of effect. This can be helpful for fighting small, fast enemies. It helps your drones as well as your ship. Do note that this will also allow large NPCs (such as Karen and Overminds) to track and hit you much more easily than usual - beware if you rely on speed-tanking!
zh: 多体追踪塔（Multibody Tracking Pylon）：为其作用范围内的所有舰船（包括 NPC）提供跟踪加成。这有助于对付体型小、速度快的敌人，对你的无人机和你的舰船都有帮助。注意，这也会让大型 NPC（如 Karen 和 Overmind）比平时更容易跟上并击中你——如果你靠速度坦，务必当心！

blocks.en: Enemies
blocks.zh: 敌人

blocks.en: Abyssal Deadspace contains a wide variety of different hostile NPCs. Each NPC will behave differently, and taking the right combat approach in different situations is important. The following discussion covers all the different types of NPCs and their abilities; for an overview of the possible sets of NPCs you can face in an Abyssal room, see Possible rooms in Abyssal Deadspace.
blocks.zh: 深渊中有各种各样的敌对 NPC。每种 NPC 的行为都不同，在不同情况下采取正确的战斗方式很重要。下面介绍所有类型的 NPC 及其能力；关于深渊房间中可能遇到的 NPC 组合概览，请参阅深渊中可能出现的房间。

blocks.en: Unlike in most other regions in EVE, Abyssal Deadspace NPCs have very clear naming patterns and will have either a prefix or suffix that states what special abilities they have.
blocks.zh: 与 EVE 大多数其他区域不同，深渊 NPC 的命名规律非常清晰，会用前缀或后缀标明它们具有什么特殊能力。

blocks.en: This makes target prioritization easier, which is extremely important in the Abyss: the general best strategy in most rooms is to start out by killing any EWAR that poses a threat to your ship. Depending on your fit, this can mean Neutralizers, Webs, Warp scramblers, Tracking/Guidance disruptors, or, if the pocket has battleships, Target Painters.
blocks.zh: 这让确定目标优先级变得更容易，而这在深渊中极其重要：在大多数房间中，通常最好的策略是先击杀对你的舰船有威胁的电子战单位。视你的装配而定，可能是能量中和、停滞网、跃迁扰频、索敌/制导干扰，如果口袋里有战列舰的话，还有目标标记。

blocks.en: You should also pay attention on whether dedicated remote repair ships are on grid; if you can't kill other frigates before repairs land, prioritize killing remote repairs first. After the dangerous EWAR and remote repair ships are dead, you can focus on the damage dealers in your preferred order.
blocks.zh: 你还应该留意场上是否有专门的远程维修舰船；如果你无法在维修生效前打掉其他护卫舰，就优先击杀远程维修舰船。危险的电子战和远程维修舰船死掉后，就可以按你喜欢的顺序集中火力打输出单位了。

blocks.en: Rogue Drones
blocks.zh: 自由无人机

blocks.en: Rogue Drones are perhaps the most common type of enemies encountered in Abyssal Deadspace, and come in three sizes: Frigate, Battlecruiser, and Battleship. Rogue Drone Frigates can often be found in rooms containing extremely large groups of them, alongside other larger Rogue Drones, or even alongside ships from other factions. Rogue Drone Battlecruisers are somewhat slow and have very short range (only 2+4km), but have pinpoint tracking within that range and extremely high damage. The Rogue Drone Battleship ("Abyssal Overmind") has extremely long range and damage, comes in a different variant at each Abyssal Filament level, and is discussed further, later in this page.
blocks.zh: 自由无人机可能是深渊中最常见的敌人，分为三种尺寸：护卫舰、战列巡洋舰和战列舰。自由无人机护卫舰经常成大群出现在房间里，与其他更大的自由无人机一起，甚至和其他势力的舰船一起出现。自由无人机战列巡洋舰速度较慢、射程很短（只有 2+4km），但在这个范围内跟踪极准、伤害极高。自由无人机战列舰（“Abyssal Overmind”）射程极远、伤害极高，在每个深渊纤维等级都有不同的变体，本页后面会进一步介绍。

blocks.en: Rogue Drone Frigates deal either a single type of damage based on their name, or a small amount of omni damage alongside EWAR. Rogue Drone Frigates are also susceptible to Deviant Automata Suppressor pylons, but if those are not available, they can be much more easily fought using Multibody Tracking Pylons or Bioluminescent Clouds.
blocks.zh: 自由无人机护卫舰要么根据名字造成单一类型的伤害，要么在使用电子战的同时造成少量全类型伤害。自由无人机护卫舰也会受到异常自动机抑制器的伤害，如果没有这种塔，借助多体追踪塔或生物荧光云来打它们会容易得多。

blocks.en: Rogue Drone Battlecruisers also deal only a single type of damage, based on their name.
blocks.zh: 自由无人机战列巡洋舰也只根据名字造成单一类型的伤害。

blocks.en: The Rogue Drone Battleship deals Kinetic and Thermal damage, and the Battleship found in Tier 5 and 6 sites also has a Stasis Webifier, which helps counteract its poor tracking.
blocks.zh: 自由无人机战列舰造成动能和热能伤害，5 级和 6 级站点中的战列舰还带有停滞缠绕光束，可以弥补其较差的跟踪。

blocks.en: Rogue Drone Battleships have a small exploitable gimmick - if a generic damage dealer frigate (e.g. Sparkneedle Tessella) spawns, the battleship follows it in orbit and as a result will draw close to you, as Rogue Drone Frigates naturally orbit close to your ship (minus the repair frigates). This can greatly help afterburner-fit ships which normally can't easily get under the battleship's guns, but can also become problematic in high tier sites as it may put you within their webifier range.
blocks.zh: 自由无人机战列舰有个可以利用的小把戏——如果刷出了普通输出型护卫舰（例如 Sparkneedle Tessella），战列舰会跟着它环绕，从而靠近你，因为自由无人机护卫舰（维修护卫舰除外）天然会贴近你的舰船环绕。这对平时很难钻到战列舰炮口下方的加力燃烧器装配舰船帮助很大，但在高等级站点中也可能带来麻烦，因为这可能让你进入它的停滞网范围。

blocks.en: Rogue Drone Frigate names have the suffix Tessella. Rogue Drone Battlecruiser names have the suffix Tessera.
blocks.zh: 自由无人机护卫舰的名字带有后缀 Tessella。自由无人机战列巡洋舰的名字带有后缀 Tessera。

en: Battlecruiser, short range but extreme damage
zh: 战列巡洋舰，射程短但伤害极高

blocks.en: Drifters and Seekers
blocks.zh: 流浪者与搜寻者

blocks.en: Drifters and seekers are sometimes encountered together but can also appear on their own. They all fire omni-damage turrets and have flat omni-resist profiles.
blocks.zh: 流浪者和搜寻者（Seeker）有时会一起出现，也可能单独出现。它们都使用全伤害类型的炮台，抗性也是均匀的全抗。

blocks.en: The key ship in a Drifter room is Karybdis Tyrannos, who flies a Drifter Battleship. This battleship has extremely long range, and will attempt to fly away from your ship(s) at around 300m/s, to drag you to the edge of the abyssal pocket.
blocks.zh: 流浪者房间的关键舰船是 Karybdis Tyrannos，它驾驶的是一艘流浪者战列舰。这艘战列舰射程极远，会以约 300m/s 的速度试图远离你的舰船，把你拖到深渊口袋的边缘。

blocks.en: This can be very irritating, as it forces you to fly all the way back to the exit gate after the battleship finally dies. During the time spent chasing the battleship, you are vulnerable to its poorly-tracking but hard-hitting turrets. The strength of the battleship varies with the level of the Abyssal filament; higher-level filaments feature more damage and HP. Thankfully, the Drifter Battleship here does not come with either a Doomsday Weapon or any EWAR abilities.
blocks.zh: 这非常烦人，因为等战列舰终于死掉后，你得一路飞回出口传送门。在追击战列舰期间，你会暴露在它跟踪差但伤害高的炮台之下。战列舰的强度随深渊纤维等级而变化，等级越高伤害和血量越高。所幸这里的流浪者战列舰既没有末日武器，也没有任何电子战能力。

blocks.en: The same gimmick that applies to Rogue Drone Battleships also applies to Drifter battleships, albeit even easier to exploit, which can greatly benefit afterburner-focused cruisers; if the pocket happens to spawn an Ephialtes Lancer, the battleship will follow it in orbit and as a result move closer to you, making it significantly easier to get under its guns and save a lot of stress. This does not work with any other Sleeper/Drifter cruiser types.
blocks.zh: 适用于自由无人机战列舰的那个小把戏同样适用于流浪者战列舰，而且更容易利用，对以加力燃烧器为主的巡洋舰帮助很大：如果口袋里刚好刷出了 Ephialtes Lancer，战列舰会跟着它环绕，从而靠近你，让你更容易钻到它的炮口下方，省去很多麻烦。其他冬眠者/流浪者巡洋舰都不行。

blocks.en: Drifter ships start the fight with pre-existing damage; cruisers have 24% shields, 14% armor (~50% in Firestorm) and 30% hull, while the battleship's damage varies according to the filament tier. Drifter cruisers all use some form of EWAR in addition to dealing damage, but they also have large signature radii and are thus easy to finish off.
blocks.zh: 流浪者舰船在战斗开始时就已经带伤：巡洋舰只有 24% 护盾、14% 装甲（火瀑中约 50%）和 30% 结构，而战列舰的受损程度随纤维等级而变化。流浪者巡洋舰除了造成伤害外都会使用某种电子战，但它们的信号半径很大，因此很容易收掉。

blocks.en: Seeker ships are far more generic than Drifter ships, and while they feature many forms of EWAR, they also have only thin armor. They all have the Ephialtes prefix.
blocks.zh: 搜寻者舰船比流浪者舰船普通得多，虽然带有多种电子战，但装甲很薄。它们都有 Ephialtes 前缀。

blocks.en: Drifter Cruisers will all be namedScylla Tyrannos, and so their type must be checked to see their abilities.
blocks.zh: 流浪者巡洋舰的名字全都是Scylla Tyrannos，因此必须查看它们的类型才能知道其能力。

blocks.en: Sleeper Drones
blocks.zh: 冬眠者无人机

blocks.en: Every Sleeper drone is equipped with remote repairers, so it is best to kill smaller ships first, as they die before repairs land. In addition to damage, they will also use webs and energy neutralizers. The Sleeper drone battleship (Lucid Deepwatcher) spawns alone in T1 and 2, in pairs in T3 and 4, and in trios in T5 and 6. It starts with 50% armor (65% in Firestorm) and 65% structure, and deals strong EM/Thermal damage, but has very poor tracking (worse than the Drifter battleship), and its Kinetic/Explosive missiles have poor application and will generally not hit at all unless you are extremely close to it. Its damage can easily be evaded with a sub-10km orbit, though it has some of the strongest tank of any Abyssal enemy and usually kills via timeout.
blocks.zh: 每架冬眠者无人机都装有远程维修器，所以最好先杀小船，它们会在维修生效前死掉。除了造成伤害，它们还会使用停滞网和能量中和器。冬眠者无人机战列舰（Lucid Deepwatcher）在 1、2 级单独出现，3、4 级成对出现，5、6 级三艘一起出现。它开局只有 50% 装甲（火瀑中 65%）和 65% 结构，造成很强的电磁/热能伤害，但跟踪非常差（比流浪者战列舰还差），其动能/爆炸导弹的伤害投射也很差，除非你离它非常近，否则一般根本打不中。只要以 10km 以内环绕就能轻松躲开它的伤害，不过它的坦度在所有深渊敌人中名列前茅，通常是因为超时而要人命。

blocks.en: Sleeper drones fire EM/Thermal turrets (and the cruisers have irritatingly high tracking and range), and Kinetic/explosive missiles (with poor flight speed and application).
blocks.zh: 冬眠者无人机使用电磁/热能炮台（巡洋舰的跟踪和射程高得让人恼火），以及动能/爆炸导弹（飞行速度和伤害投射都很差）。

blocks.en: Sleeper Drones all have the Lucid prefix.
blocks.zh: 冬眠者无人机都有 Lucid 前缀。

blocks.en: Triglavian Collective
blocks.zh: 三神裔

blocks.en: Triglavian ships can often appear alongside Rogue Drone spawns (though never with the drone battleship). They use Entropic Disintegrators to deal high Thermal and Explosive damage. As each ship's damage will slowly increase the longer it stays focused on one target, Triglavian rooms can quickly become DPS or range-control races, to either kill their high-damage ships before they can kill you or to kill their tackle ships and fly beyond their damage range.
blocks.zh: 三神裔舰船经常与自由无人机一起出现（但从不与无人机战列舰一起）。它们使用熵能分解者造成高额热能和爆炸伤害。由于每艘船锁定同一目标的时间越长伤害就越高，三神裔房间很快就会变成拼输出或拼距离控制：要么在它们的高伤害舰船打死你之前先干掉它们，要么先干掉它们的拦截舰船，然后飞出它们的伤害范围。

blocks.en: With the exception of neuting types, Triglavian ships all feature Remote Armor Repair abilities, and mount the widest range of EWAR of any Abyssal faction.
blocks.zh: 除中和型外，三神裔舰船都具有远程装甲维修能力，而且搭载的电子战种类是所有深渊势力中最多的。

en: Very fast frigate. Large signature radius.
Harder-hitting battlecruiser. Spawns with 37% shield, 69% armor and 11% hull.
Long-range, slow, high-damage battleship. Spawns with 46% hull (less for Tangling and Renewing variants) and no shields or armor (though they gain ~40% armor in Firestorm).

3 or 4 Vila Swarmers will be spawned by NPCs that have "Vila" as the middle name (example: Striking Vila Damavik). Deals very low omni DPS. (10-20 DMG per shot) Focus on destroying the controlling ships since the Swarmers will deactivate when they are destroyed, and the gate will still unlock regardless of if they are alive or not.
zh: 速度极快的护卫舰，信号半径大。
速度快、射程远的驱逐舰
低伤害的远程维修巡洋舰
伤害更高的战列巡洋舰。出现时只有 37% 护盾、69% 装甲和 11% 结构。
远程、低速、高伤害的战列舰。出现时只有 46% 结构（Tangling 和 Renewing 变体更少），没有护盾和装甲（不过在火瀑中会有约 40% 装甲）。
能量中和器，无远程维修。
名字中间带有“Vila”的 NPC（例如 Striking Vila Damavik）会召唤 3 或 4 个 Vila Swarmer。它们造成的全类型每秒伤害很低（每发 10-20 点伤害）。集中火力击毁召唤它们的舰船即可，因为控制舰被摧毁后 Swarmer 会失效，而且不管 Swarmer 是否还活着，传送门都会解锁。

blocks.en: Sansha's Nation
blocks.zh: 萨沙共和国

blocks.en: Sansha's Nation ships have slow speed, deal large amounts of EM/Thermal damage and are most safely fought at long range. Fighting them up close is a challenge, as they bring a wide range of EWAR abilities, including significant energy neutralizers.
blocks.zh: 萨沙共和国的舰船速度慢，造成大量电磁/热能伤害，在远距离作战最安全。近距离和它们交战很有挑战性，因为它们带有多种电子战，包括强力的能量中和器。

blocks.en: All Sansha's Nation ships have the Devoted prefix.
blocks.zh: 所有萨沙共和国舰船都有 Devoted 前缀。

en: Heavy damage dealer; high range & tracking
zh: 高伤害输出；射程远、跟踪好

blocks.en: CONCORD
blocks.zh: 统合部

blocks.en: CONCORD rooms contain a mix of CONCORD and EDENCOM ship hulls. CONCORD hulls use Thermal or Explosive missiles, while EDENCOM ships use EM-Kinetic Vorton Projectors. Marshals start off with no shields and 28% armor, while EDENCOM Thunderchilds start off with about 8% shield, no armor and 40% structure.
blocks.zh: 统合部房间里混合了统合部和伊甸联合防御阵线的船体。统合部船体使用热能或爆炸导弹，而伊甸联合防御阵线舰船使用电磁-动能电弧弦投射器。Marshal 开局没有护盾，装甲只有 28%；伊甸联合防御阵线的雷裔级开局约有 8% 护盾，没有装甲，结构 40%。

blocks.en: CONCORD rooms are generally feared by many Abyssal runners due to their high damage and heavy damage-application support. The sheer incoming DPS, combined with the multiple Webs and Target Painters, makes passive or active tanking in these rooms extremely difficult. Because of this, Marshal rats (especially Drainers) are often targeted first to reduce incoming DPS.
blocks.zh: 统合部房间伤害高、伤害投射辅助强，通常让很多深渊玩家闻之色变。巨大的受到的每秒伤害，再加上多个停滞网和目标标记，使得在这些房间里无论被动坦还是主动坦都极其困难。因此，通常会先打 Marshal（尤其是 Drainer）来降低受到的伤害。

blocks.en: While the EDENCOM ships offer no EWAR, they bring very high alpha damage on very slow fire rates, meaning that the combination of Marshal DPS and EDENCOM alpha can easily and unexpectedly break an Abyssal runner's buffer.
blocks.zh: 伊甸联合防御阵线舰船虽然没有电子战，但射速很慢、单发伤害极高，这意味着 Marshal 的持续伤害加上伊甸联合防御阵线的单发伤害，很容易出乎意料地打穿深渊玩家的缓冲。

blocks.en: The few saving graces when fighting CONCORD/EDENCOM ships are:
blocks.zh: 对付统合部/伊甸联合防御阵线舰船时，少数几个有利因素是：

en: they always deal a constant amount of damage relative to signature radius and velocity, meaning they cannot land critical hits ("Wrecking Shots").
since their damage is completely based on missile damage mechanics, maintaining transversal is a non-issue.
Vorton Projectors will chain their damage to any objects within 10km of your ship, and can thus be exploited into dealing friendly fire damage to other enemy CONCORD/EDENCOM ships
CONCORD ships have poor tank relative to their damage, which turns the room into a pure DPS race to determine whether you die first or the Marshals die first.
zh: 它们造成的伤害总是根据信号半径和速度保持恒定，也就是说不会打出暴击（“致命一击”）。
由于它们的伤害完全基于导弹伤害机制，保持横向速度毫无意义。
电弧弦投射器会把伤害连锁到你舰船 10km 范围内的任何物体上，因此可以利用这一点让它们误伤其他统合部/伊甸联合防御阵线敌舰
相对于其伤害而言，统合部舰船坦度较差，这让房间变成纯粹的输出比拼，看是你先死还是 Marshal 先死。

blocks.en: All CONCORD and EDENCOM ships have the Disparu Troop suffix.
blocks.zh: 所有统合部和伊甸联合防御阵线舰船都带有 Disparu Troop 后缀。

en: or 427 DPS Faction Rapid Heavy Missiles
zh: 或 130 DPS 重型攻击导弹
或 427 DPS 势力快速重型导弹
伊甸联合防御阵线舰船

blocks.en: A long, long time ago...
blocks.zh: 很久很久以前……

blocks.en: When the Depths of the Abyss expansion released and first introduced CONCORD spawns, Marshals used to spawn with full HP, resulting in said spawns being unfairly difficult to many players. In a later unknown update the Marshal NPCs were nerfed to provide slightly more balanced gameplay of CONCORD spawns in particular.
blocks.zh: 深渊纵深（Depths of the Abyss）版本发布并首次加入统合部刷新时，Marshal 出现时是满血的，导致这类刷新对很多玩家来说难得不合理。在之后某次不明的更新中，Marshal NPC 被削弱，让统合部刷新的玩法更平衡一些。

blocks.en: Angel Cartel
blocks.zh: 天使企业联合体

blocks.en: Angel Cartel rooms are the bane of fast and evasive ships. Angel Cartel ships have extremely high flight speeds, rather small signature radii, good range, varied damage types, and varied EWAR. The Cynabal is especially problematic, as it features all of these abilities combined in one ship.
blocks.zh: 天使企业联合体房间是高速闪避型舰船的克星。天使企业联合体的舰船飞行速度极快、信号半径很小、射程好、伤害类型多样、电子战也多样。塞纳波级尤其麻烦，因为它一艘船就集齐了所有这些能力。

blocks.en: All Angel Cartel rats have the Lucifer prefix, and deal heavy EM and Explosive damage along with a small amount of Kinetic/Thermal. The Cynabal and Dramiel can additionally spawn with an Elite prefix, with slightly increased damage, better tracking speed, even higher flight speed and a significantly stronger resist profile. The Elite Lucifer Dramiel also gains stasis web.
blocks.zh: 所有天使企业联合体的怪都有 Lucifer 前缀，造成大量电磁和爆炸伤害，外加少量动能/热能伤害。塞纳波级和德拉米尔级还可能带有 Elite 前缀，伤害略有提高，跟踪速度更好，飞行速度更高，抗性也明显更强。Elite Lucifer Dramiel 还会获得停滞网。

en: Heavy damage dealer; high range & tracking
zh: 高伤害输出；射程远、跟踪好

blocks.en: Damage to deal
blocks.zh: 应该打什么伤害

blocks.en: The Abyssal Deadspace resist penalties apply to both the player ship and to the NPCs present. Thanks to the mechanics of resist penalties, this means that damage-matching to the penalized resist will effectively earn a damage bonus equal to the resist penalty (smaller damage increase if the target has too low a base resist). So, in general, you should select your damage to match the weather.
blocks.zh: 深渊的抗性惩罚同时作用于玩家舰船和场上的 NPC。根据抗性惩罚的机制，这意味着针对被削弱的抗性选择伤害类型，相当于获得了与抗性惩罚等量的伤害加成（如果目标的基础抗性太低，伤害提升会小一些）。所以一般来说，应该根据天气选择伤害类型。

blocks.en: However, in some cases, the natural resist hole of the NPC is equal to or greater than the resist hole caused by the weather. This is the case in Dark filaments, which have no resist penalty.
blocks.zh: 不过在某些情况下，NPC 的天然抗性缺口等于或大于天气造成的抗性缺口。在没有抗性惩罚的黑暗纤维中就是这样。

en: Drifter ships, Seeker drones, and Sleeper drones have uniform resists.

Sansha's Nation ships other than the Devoted Knight are weak to EM and Thermal and strong against Kinetic and Explosive. The Devoted Knight is weak to EM, then Explosive, and strong against Thermal and Kinetic.
Angel Cartel ships are the opposite of Sansha's Nation: strong against EM and Thermal, weak to Explosive and Kinetic.
CONCORD ships have uniform resists. EDENCOM ships are weak to Thermal and EM.
Triglavian ships are weak to Explosive, then Thermal, and strong against Kinetic and EM. In a -30% Electrical filament, their EM resist is equal to Explosive resist.

Rogue drone ships have wildly varying resists. Damage-dealing and EWAR frigates have the same natural resists as a Tech 1 hull from one of the races. Repair frigates have 0 resists. Battlecruisers are slightly weak to EM/EX, and slightly more resistant to TH/KIN.
zh: 流浪者舰船、搜寻者无人机和冬眠者无人机的抗性是均匀的。
除 Devoted Knight 以外的萨沙共和国舰船怕电磁和热能，抗动能和爆炸。Devoted Knight 最怕电磁，其次是爆炸，抗热能和动能。
天使企业联合体舰船与萨沙共和国正好相反：抗电磁和热能，怕爆炸和动能。
统合部舰船的抗性是均匀的。伊甸联合防御阵线舰船怕热能和电磁。
三神裔舰船最怕爆炸，其次是热能，抗动能和电磁。在 -30% 的电子纤维中，它们的电磁抗性与爆炸抗性相等。
自由无人机舰船的抗性差异很大。输出型和电子战型护卫舰的天然抗性与某个种族的 T1 船体相同。维修护卫舰抗性为 0。战列巡洋舰稍微怕电磁/爆炸，稍微抗热能/动能。

blocks.en: The Rogue Drone Battleship's resistances change at different tiers. With one exception, the Weather-induced hole is greater than any natural resist hole, and should be targeted; however, in a Dark Filament, these resistances become relevant.
blocks.zh: 自由无人机战列舰的抗性在不同等级下会变化。除了一个例外，天气造成的抗性缺口都大于任何天然抗性缺口，应该针对天气缺口输出；但在黑暗纤维中，这些天然抗性就变得重要了。

blocks.en: If swapping damage types (i.e. through missile reloads) is possible, it should be done for these battleships. Their Shields are weak to EM damage, and the following chart lists their Armor weaknesses:
blocks.zh: 如果可以切换伤害类型（例如通过重新装填导弹），打这些战列舰时就应该切换。它们的护盾怕电磁伤害，下表列出了它们装甲的弱点：

blocks.en: Abyssal Deadspace Co-op for Frigates and Destroyers
blocks.zh: 护卫舰和驱逐舰的多人深渊

blocks.en: When the Abyss was created, the pockets were designed for a single cruiser. However, later updates allowed the Abyss to be entered with fleets of either three frigates, or two destroyers.
blocks.zh: 深渊刚推出时，口袋空间是为单艘巡洋舰设计的。不过后来的更新允许三艘护卫舰或两艘驱逐舰组成舰队进入深渊。

blocks.en: Entering the Abyss as a fleet of small ships requires 2 (for destroyers) or 3 (for frigates) of the appropriate filaments, of the same type, in a single ship's cargohold. All ships in the group must be in the same fleet.
blocks.zh: 以小船舰队进入深渊，需要在一艘船的货舱中放 2 根（驱逐舰）或 3 根（护卫舰）相应的同类型纤维。小队中的所有舰船必须在同一舰队中。

blocks.en: The pilot of the ship carrying the filaments can then use them and select the Activate For Fleet option. Doing so will consume the filaments, and rather than pulling the ship into the abyss, it will open a limited-use acceleration gate that leads to the abyss. Fleet members can then activate that acceleration gate and launch themselves into the abyss.
blocks.zh: 携带纤维的飞行员使用纤维时选择“为舰队激活（Activate For Fleet）”选项。这样会消耗纤维，但不会直接把这艘船拉进深渊，而是开启一道通往深渊、使用次数有限的加速门。舰队成员随后可以激活这道加速门进入深渊。

blocks.en: The 20-minute timer is shared by all ships in the fleet and starts counting down when the first of the ships finishes activating the acceleration gate and enters the abyssal pocket.
blocks.zh: 20 分钟计时器由舰队中所有舰船共享，从第一艘舰船完成加速门激活并进入深渊口袋时开始倒计时。

blocks.en: To compensate for the increased filament consumption and the loot being split across 2 or 3 ships and pilots, the Biocombinative Cache found in multi-ship pockets contains significantly more loot than the ordinary Bioadaptive Cache.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补纤维消耗增加以及拾取物要分给 2 到 3 艘船和飞行员，多舰口袋中的生物组合储藏（Biocombinative Cache）所含的拾取物比普通的生物适应性储藏多得多。

blocks.en: Players are not required to do 2-ship or 3-ship Abyssals in 2 or 3 ships. One tactic used by experienced Abyssal runners is to activate three filaments for three ships--significantly boosting the available loot--and then run the resulting pockets alone. Since the pockets will be balanced for three ships, not one, this requires careful planning and fitting and is not for the faint-of-heart. It does, however, markedly increase the profits made by successful runners.
blocks.zh: 玩家并不一定要用 2 艘或 3 艘船去刷双舰或三舰深渊。有经验的深渊玩家会用一种打法：为三艘船激活三根纤维——大幅增加可获得的拾取物——然后独自刷开出来的口袋。由于口袋是按三艘船而不是一艘船平衡的，这需要周密的规划和装配，不适合胆小的人。不过成功的话，收益会显著提高。

blocks.en: Abyssal Deadspace from the outside
blocks.zh: 从外部看深渊

blocks.en: Orange glow means it is a tier 1-3 Abyssal Deadspace. Yellow glow means it is a tier 4-6 Abyssal Deadspace.
blocks.zh: 橙色光芒表示这是 1-3 级深渊。黄色光芒表示这是 4-6 级深渊。

blocks.en: When you enter an Abyssal, you will be removed from the Local chat channel in your system of origin and from the directional scanner. You cannot see who is in the system outside the deadspace, and they cannot see who is inside or in what ship they are using.
blocks.zh: 进入深渊后，你会从出发星系的本地频道和定向扫描中消失。你看不到死亡空间外的星系里有谁，他们也看不到里面是谁、开的什么船。

blocks.en: But that does not mean you are wholly safe. Once the filament has been used, a rift appears that can be combat scanned by anyone in the system and can be warped to. It also appears on the directional scanner of anyone who has not filtered it out. This makes it possible for people to camp the exit and shoot whoever comes out.
blocks.zh: 但这并不意味着你就完全安全了。纤维一经使用，就会出现一道裂隙，星系里的任何人都可以用战斗探针扫到并跃迁过去。没有把它过滤掉的人，也能在定向扫描中看到它。这使得别人可以蹲守出口，攻击出来的人。

blocks.en: This means that you have to consider where you use the filament, especially in low security and null security space. Even in high-security space you should be cautious, especially when running high tiers, since they often require blingy ship fittings and thus provide tempting targets for suicide ganking. It is best to activate the filament at a safespot bookmark, preferably more than directional-scanner range (14.3 AU) away from any celestial and any frequently-warped routes. Experienced Abyssal runners find large systems where they can set up such bookmarks, and replace their bookmarks frequently.
blocks.zh: 这意味着你必须考虑在哪里使用纤维，尤其是在低安和 00 区。即便在高安也应该谨慎，特别是刷高等级深渊时，因为高等级深渊往往需要奢华的装配，容易成为自杀式攻击的诱人目标。最好在安全点书签处激活纤维，最好距离任何天体和常用跃迁路线都超过定向扫描范围（14.3 AU）。有经验的深渊玩家会找那些可以设置这种书签的大星系，并经常更换书签。

blocks.en: You will be invulnerable for a short time when you leave the Abyss. If you leave the rift and find yourself being camped, pause to assess your best options, and stay calm. One survival tactic is to quickly activate a new filament, but players who know you can do this will anchor a mobile depot nearby, preventing filament activation. Based on your assessment of the situation, you will have to decide.
blocks.zh: 离开深渊时你会有短暂的无敌时间。如果你出了裂隙发现自己被蹲守，先停下来评估最佳选择，保持冷静。一种求生办法是迅速激活一根新纤维，但知道你会这么做的玩家会在附近锚定一个移动式仓库，阻止你激活纤维。你得根据对局势的判断自己做决定。

blocks.en: Rewards
blocks.zh: 奖励

blocks.en: Abyssal Deadspace is dangerous, but the rewards can be worthwhile. Abyssal Deadspace is the only source for many valuable items found in the Caches and Extraction Nodes/Subnodes. No wrecks are left behind by any NPCs, and all drops come from these two listed cans.
blocks.zh: 深渊很危险，但奖励可能物有所值。许多有价值的物品只能从深渊的储藏和提取节点/子节点中获得。NPC 不会留下任何残骸，所有掉落都来自这两种货柜。

blocks.en: The (mostly) Abyssal-exclusive rewards are as follows:
blocks.zh: （基本上）深渊独有的奖励如下：

en: Mutaplasmids that can be used to change the stats of certain modules. Which mutaplasmids are able to drop depends on the weather selected:
Gamma sites can drop shield related mutaplasmids - S/M/L Shield Extender, S/M/L/XL Shield Booster
Dark sites can drop propulsion module mutaplasmids - 1/10/100MN Afterburner, 5/50/500MN Microwarpdrive
Firestorm sites can drop armor related mutaplasmids - S/M/L Armor Plate, S/M/L Armor Repairer
Electrical sites can drop capacitor related mutaplasmids - S/M/L Cap Battery, S/M/L Energy Neutralizer, S/M/L Energy Nosferatu
Exotic sites can drop tackle related mutaplasmids - Stasis Webifier, Warp Disruptor, Warp Scrambler
All weathers can drop damage module mutaplasmids - Heat Sink, Gyrostabilizer, Magnetic Field Stabilizer, Ballistic Control System, Entropic Radiation Sink

Additionally can drop harvesting mutaplasmids - Gas Cloud Harvester, Gas Cloud Scoop, Ice Harvester, Ice Mining Laser, Mining Laser, Deep Core Mining Laser, Modulated Deep Core (Strip) Miner, all other Strip Miner types
Smartbomb mutaplasmids based on the weather being run (e.g. Electrical filament = EMP Smartbomb mutaplasmid)
T6 filaments can drop capital module mutaplasmids - All capital-sized versions of the modules above, plus Ancillary Shield Booster/Armor Repairer, Heavy Warp Disruptor/Scrambler, and Siege Module
Precursor ship and weapon skill books, disintegrator specialization skill books
Blueprint copies required for the production of Triglavian hulls, weapon systems, modules and ammunition:
Entropic Disintegrators: Weapons with unique properties and only usable by the Triglavian ships
T1, Meta and Faction (Veles) variants will drop; T2 weapons must be researched like normal.
Exotic Plasma: Ammunition used by Entropic Disintegrators. Only Tech 1 BPCs will drop; Tech 2s must be researched like normal. All BPC types are 5-run.
XL-size (capital) Exotic Plasma BPCs will only drop from T4s and higher.

1-run blueprint copies for "Glorified" mutaplasmids can also drop, which require mutaplasmid residue (obtained from reprocessing Abyssal modules) to build. Essentially a side-grade of the normal mutaplasmid types, as they have a larger mutation range in both positive and negative direction.
Mutadaptive Remote Armor Repairer: A special remote armor repairer module used by the Triglavian Rodiva and Zarmazd logistics cruisers
Perun Heavy Mutadaptive Remote Armor Repairer - a faction version of the Mutadaptive Remote Armor Repairer
Production materials required for the production of Triglavian hulls, weapon systems, and ammunition:
Compact Entropic Radiation Sink - a compact (low-fitting) version of the Entropic Radiation Sink

Triglavian Survey Database: often referred to as "red loot", this item is an ISK token item similar to Sleeper "blue loot" and Overseer's Personal Effects in that it can be sold to unlimited NPC buy orders for a fixed price, in this case, 100,000 ISK/ea
data hacking sites are the only source for Abyssal filaments outside of Abyssal Deadspace, and they only provide Tranquil (Tier 0) and Calm (Tier 1) filaments

the Bioadaptive/Biocombinative Caches in Abyssal Deadspace can drop filaments of all tiers, though the pool of filament drops seems to be limited by the tier of the filament used. Example: if running a T3, any filament from T0-T3 can drop, plus any filament up to two tiers up (T4, T5). Running T4 is the bare minimum for dropping the highest tier (T6) filament.
it is therefore only by running Abyssals that the filaments for higher-tier Abyssal runs can be found, and there is a busy market in retrieved filaments
Abyssal Deadspace is also one source from which players can acquire crates for SKINR sequencers and design elements.
zh: 突变质体，可用来改变某些装备的属性。能掉落哪些突变质体取决于所选的天气：
伽玛站点可能掉落护盾类突变质体——小/中/大型护盾扩展装置，小/中/大/超大型护盾回充增量器
黑暗站点可能掉落推进装备突变质体——1/10/100MN 加力燃烧器，5/50/500MN 微型跃迁推进器
火瀑站点可能掉落装甲类突变质体——小/中/大型装甲附甲板，小/中/大型装甲维修器
电子站点可能掉落电容类突变质体——小/中/大型电容器电池，小/中/大型能量中和器，小/中/大型掠能器
异种站点可能掉落拦截类突变质体——停滞缠绕光束、跃迁扰断器、跃迁扰频器
所有天气都可能掉落伤害装备突变质体——散热槽、回转稳定器、磁场稳定器、弹道控制系统、熵辐射槽
此外还可能掉落采集类突变质体——气云采集器、气云回收装置、冰矿采集器、冰矿开采激光器、采矿激光器、深层地核采矿激光器、调制型深层地核（露天）采矿器以及其他所有露天采矿器类型
与所刷天气对应的立体炸弹突变质体（例如电子纤维 = EMP 立体炸弹突变质体）
T6 纤维可能掉落旗舰装备突变质体——上述所有装备的旗舰尺寸版本，外加辅助护盾回充增量器/辅助装甲维修器、重型跃迁扰断器/扰频器以及会战装备
先驱者舰船和武器技能书，分解者专精技能书
生产三神裔船体、武器系统、装备和弹药所需的蓝图拷贝：
熵能分解者：具有独特属性的武器，只能由三神裔舰船使用
会掉落 T1、Meta 和势力（暗泽裔）型号；T2 武器需要像平常一样通过研究获得。
异种等离子弹药：熵能分解者使用的弹药。只掉落 T1 蓝图拷贝；T2 需要像平常一样通过研究获得。所有蓝图拷贝都是 5 流程。
超大尺寸（旗舰）异种等离子弹药蓝图拷贝只在 T4 及以上掉落。
还可能掉落 1 流程的“荣耀型”突变质体蓝图拷贝，制造时需要突变质体残渣（通过提炼深渊装备获得）。它们基本上是普通突变质体的平行替代品，正负两个方向的突变范围都更大。
突变适应远程装甲维修器：三神裔洛迪瓦级和扎玛德级后勤巡洋舰使用的一种特殊远程装甲维修装备
雷电裔重型突变适应远程装甲维修器——突变适应远程装甲维修器的势力版本
生产三神裔船体、武器系统和弹药所需的生产材料：
紧凑型熵辐射槽——熵辐射槽的紧凑型（低装配需求）版本
三神裔调查数据库：常被称为“红战利品”，这是一种 ISK 兑换物品，类似冬眠者的“蓝战利品”和监察官的个人财产，可以按固定价格卖给数量无限的 NPC 买单，这里是每个 100,000 ISK
数据破解站点是深渊之外唯一的深渊纤维来源，而且只提供宁静（0 级）和镇静（1 级）纤维
深渊中的生物适应性/生物组合储藏可以掉落所有等级的纤维，不过掉落池似乎受所用纤维等级的限制。例如：刷 T3 时，可能掉落 T0-T3 的任何纤维，外加最多高两级的纤维（T4、T5）。至少要刷 T4 才可能掉落最高等级（T6）的纤维。
因此，只有刷深渊才能获得更高等级深渊所需的纤维，回收纤维的市场交易也很活跃
深渊也是玩家获取 SKINR 序列器和设计元素箱子的来源之一。
